lemma mayOpen (h : Tabs a) (m : ℕ) : ∃ b, opens a s m b := by
  by_cases hs : 0≤s
  · have hu i : a.S.a (i+1)* (a.clock.coverSize (i+1):ℝ)^ (2:ℕ) ≤
        ((2:ℝ)/3)*(a.S.a i * (a.clock.coverSize i:ℝ)^ (2:ℕ)) := by
      have hb : (a.clock.coverSize (i+1):ℝ)^ (2:ℕ) ≤ 2*(a.clock.coverSize i:ℝ)^ (2:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast h.grows i
      rw [a.S.a_step]
      have ha := a.S.a_pos i
      apply le_trans (mul_le_mul (b:=a.S.a i/3) ?_ hb (by positivity) (by positivity)) (by ring_nf; rfl)
      gcongr; exact_mod_cast a.S.block_large i
    let f (i : ℕ) := a.S.a i * ((a.clock.coverSize i:ℝ)^ (2:ℕ))
    have hv i : f i ≤ f 0*((2:ℝ)/3)^i := by
      induction i with
      | zero => simp
      | succ i ih => apply (hu i).trans; apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by positivity : 0≤(2:ℝ)/3)).trans_eq; ring
    have ht : Tendsto (fun i : ℕ => s*f i) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      have he : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0) := squeeze_zero (fun i => mul_nonneg (a.S.a_pos i).le (sq_nonneg _)) hv (by
        simpa only [mul_zero] using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (r:= (2:ℝ)/3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).const_mul (f 0))
      simpa only [mul_zero] using he.const_mul s
    obtain ⟨i,H,he⟩ := ((eventually_ge_atTop m).and (ht.eventually (ge_mem_nhds
       (a.S.a_pos m)))).exists
    refine ⟨i,H,(le_div_iff₀ (a.S.a_pos _)).2 (le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) (show s*f i≤_ from he))⟩
    unfold f; ring
  refine ⟨m,le_rfl,(mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_not_ge hs) (by positivity)).trans (div_nonneg (a.S.a_pos m).le (a.S.a_pos m).le)⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Using coverSize^2 growth by at most 2 per level, a_i b_i^2 decreases by factor 2/3, so an opening level exists; chosen is the minimal one (Nat.find).

lemma pay (h : Tabs a) (hs : 1≤s) (e : ℝ) (he : 0<e) :
    ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop,
      let p := chosen a s h m
      (a.S.a m / a.S.a p)^4* Vac.fiat G (a.params p) (a.clock.hatBeta p) ≤ e * a.S.scale p := by
  have hw : ∀ᶠ m : ℕ in atTop, ∀ i ≥ m-1,
      ((a.S.block i).val * ((a.clock.coverSize i:ℝ)^2))^(4:ℕ) * Vac.fiat G (a.params (i+1)) (a.clock.hatBeta (i+1)) ≤
        (e/s^4) * a.S.scale (i+1) := by
    have hn : 0 < s := by linarith
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := eventually_atTop.1 (h.cheap (e/s^4) (by positivity))
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop j] with i hg k hk using hj _ (by omega)
  filter_upwards [hw,eventually_gt_atTop 0] with i hi hp
  dsimp only
  have hv := (opened a s h i).1
  cases hg : chosen a s h i with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m =>
    have hh := hi m (by omega)
    have hf (q : ℕ) : 0≤Vac.fiat G (a.params q) (a.clock.hatBeta q) := by
      unfold Vac.fiat
      have hu := (a.params q).clip.quadratic_pos
      have hx := (a.params q).paths_pos
      have he := Real.log_pos (a.fits.delayed q)
      positivity
    calc
      _ ≤ (s*((a.S.block m).val*(a.clock.coverSize m:ℝ)^ (2:ℕ)))^(4:ℕ) * Vac.fiat G (a.params (m+1)) (a.clock.hatBeta (m+1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (div_nonneg (a.S.a_pos _).le (a.S.a_pos _).le) (expensive a s h hs i m hg) 4) (hf (m+1))
      _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [mul_pow,mul_assoc]
        refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (show 0 ≤ s^4 by positivity)).trans_eq ?_
        have hn := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1) hs)
        field_simp

proof_context.conclusion: Minimality of chosen (needs/expensive) gives (a_m/a_{k_*})^4 * fiat_{k_*} <= e * s_{k_*} eventually, for every e > 0.

lemma stock_step : Tendsto (fun i=> C.S.scale i/C.S.scale (J i)) atTop (𝓝 1):=by
    let x i:= C.S.scale (J i)
    let y:= C.S.scale
    have he(i): i ≤ J i:= (Stock.Tabs.opened _ _ _ i).1
    have hp:Tendsto J atTop atTop:= tendsto_atTop_mono he tendsto_id
    have hz:Tendsto x atTop atTop:= C.S.divergent.comp hp
    rw [tendsto_order]; constructor
    · intro r hr; obtain ⟨v,hv,hv'⟩:= exists_between (sub_pos.mpr hr);
      filter_upwards [Stock.Tabs.pay C.path.levels 1 t le_rfl v hv,hz.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with i hi ht
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ ht]
      let u := C.S.a i/C.S.a (J i)
      let B := Vac.fiat G (P'|>.params (J i)) (P'|>.clock.hatBeta (J i))
      have hs : 1≤u := (one_le_div (C.S.a_pos _)).2 (C.S.strictAnti.antitone (he i))
      have hF : x i-y i=Real.log u := by
         unfold x y Schedule.scale u; rw [Real.log_div (C.S.a_pos _).ne' (C.S.a_pos _).ne', Real.log_inv, Real.log_inv]; ring
      have hB : 1 ≤ B:= stock_fiat C _
      have hW : x i-y i ≤ v*x i:= by
         rw [hF]; calc
            _ ≤ u:= Real.log_le_self (by linarith)
            _ ≤ u^4 := by nth_rw 1 [← pow_one u]; exact pow_le_pow_right₀ hs (by norm_num)
            _ ≤ u^4*B:= le_mul_of_one_le_right (by positivity) hB
            _ ≤ _ := hi
      change r*x i < y i; linarith only [hW,mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hv' ht]
    intro r hr; filter_upwards [hz.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with i hi using lt_of_le_of_lt ((div_le_one hi).2 ((scale_mono C.S).monotone (he i))) hr

lemma stock_price (hG:G.Simple) (h:Height C.S l T m a)(hT:Tendsto T l atTop) : RateLE l T (fun i=> stakes C (m i) (J (m i))) 0 :=by
    cases l.eq_or_neBot with
    | inl hh=> rw [hh]; intro r _; simp
    | inr hl =>
    let v i:= C.S.a (m i)/C.S.a (J (m i)); intro r hr; let u:=r/3/(1+a)
    have ha:=h.nonneg hT; have hf:0< u:= div_pos (by positivity) (by positivity); have hs :u*(a+1)+r/3 ≤ r:=by unfold u; rw [add_comm a 1, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by linarith only [ha])]; linarith only [hr]
    filter_upwards [h.grows.eventually (Stock.Tabs.pay C.path.levels 1 t le_rfl u hf),
       (h.stock t).grows.eventually (Vac.treasury_stage C.path.levels hG),
       (h.stock t).pace.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (show a<a+1 by linarith)),hT.eventually_gt_atTop 0,(hT.const_mul_atTop (div_pos hr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 3))).eventually_ge_atTop 5] with i hi hv he hT he'
    rw [stakes,Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]; apply Real.exp_monotone
    let z:= J (m i); have hZ:C.S.scale z /T i<a+1:= he; have hε:= le_of_lt ((div_lt_iff₀ hT).1 hZ); have hp:v i^4 * Vac.treasury (P') z ≤ u*C.S.scale z:= le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hv (by positivity)) hi
    have he':= show (5:ℝ) ≤ (r/3)*T i from he'; change v i^4 * Vac.treasury _ z +_ ≤ _; linarith only [he',hp,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε hf.le, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs hT.le]

proof_context.conclusion: log stakes(m, k_*(m)) has rate at most 0 in T along a height sequence (log S_k = o(T)).

lemma whence : Tendsto (fun i=> Real.sqrt (H i)/C.S.scale i) atTop (𝓝 0):=by
   have ht : Tendsto (H) atTop atTop:= tendsto_atTop_add_const_left _ _ (C.S.divergent.const_mul_atTop (Gauge.slopeConstant_pos hG))
   have he:Tendsto (fun i=> H i / C.S.scale i) atTop (𝓝 G.slopeConstant):= by
       have hp : Tendsto (fun i=> C.path.levels.clock.bar/C.S.scale i) atTop (𝓝 0) := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop C.S.divergent
       refine (show Tendsto (fun i=> C.path.levels.clock.bar/C.S.scale i+G.slopeConstant) atTop (𝓝 G.slopeConstant) from by simpa only [zero_add] using! hp.add_const G.slopeConstant).congr' ?_; filter_upwards [C.S.divergent.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with i hi; change _= (C.path.levels.clock.bar+G.slopeConstant* Q i)/_; rw [add_div,mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hi.ne']
   have hx:Tendsto (fun i=> (Real.sqrt (H i))⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0):=by simp_rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]; exact tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp ((tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num)).comp ht)
   refine (show Tendsto (fun i=> H i/Q i*(Real.sqrt (H i))⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0) from by simpa using! he.mul hx).congr' ?_
   filter_upwards with i; let y:=H i; have hp: 0<y:=zero_lt_one.trans (C.path.levels.fits.delayed _); have hf:= Real.mul_self_sqrt hp.le; change y/_*(Real.sqrt y)⁻¹= Real.sqrt y/_; nth_rw 1 [← hf]; have hv:0<Real.sqrt y:= Real.sqrt_pos.2 hp; ring_nf; field_simp

proof_context.conclusion: sqrt(hatBeta_i)/s_i -> 0 from hatBeta = bar + slope*s, so exp sqrt(hatBeta) has Note rate 0 (log Xi_m = o(s_m)).
